headline: Wagamama starts taking table bookings for the first time in its 34-year history.
body: The walk-in-only chain now accepts same-day and advance bookings for groups of any size through OpenTable, its website and app; groups of 20 or more book by phone. The company says the change followed a trial and guest requests, and is pushing it with a festive set menu at £23 for two courses.
why: The UK's largest Japanese-inspired chain is giving up a format rule it has kept since 1992, a sign that casual dining now competes on convenience and occasion bookings, not just on queue-and-eat.
